summary: Initialize one stable configured target identity in ignored local config.
intent: Make correction-event, target-guidance, and suitability identity constructible without inventing a target id or adding checked-in target residue.

reads.description: Configured target profiles and current target.

writes.description: One stable target_id in ignored local configuration.
writes.when: not a dry run and the profile has no stable id

guards: The target profile must resolve uniquely before a target id is proposed.
Generated ids are collision-checked against every configured stable target id.
An optional config digest provides compare-and-swap admission.
The operation never writes checked-in target identity residue.

steps.description: Plan or apply the local target identity initialization.

proof: Generated Python and TypeScript clients exercise dry-run, apply, idempotency, collision, and rename-continuity behavior.
Config projection exposes the same repair operation before correction submission.
